---
title: "FCM"
output: html_notebook
---
# Manual Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) on 10 points, 2 clusters
# Own code for: (1) centroid computation
#               (2) distance -> membership conversion

set.seed(2)

## ---- 1. Generate 10 points from 2 clusters ------------------------

```{r}
n       <- 10
cluster <- rep(1:2, each = 5)                 # true cluster labels
centers <- rbind(c(2, 2), c(8, 8))            # true cluster centres
dataset <- cbind(
  x = centers[cluster, 1] + rnorm(n, sd = 0.8),
  y = centers[cluster, 2] + rnorm(n, sd = 0.8)
)
rownames(dataset) <- paste0("P", 1:n)
print(round(dataset, 3))

plot(dataset, col = cluster, pch = 19, main = "Raw data (true clusters)")
text(dataset, labels = rownames(dataset), pos = 3, cex = 0.8)
```

## ---- 2. Parameters -------------------------------------------------
```{r}
m <- 2        # fuzzifier (m > 1)
c <- 2        # number of clusters
```

## ---- 3. Own functions ----------------------------------------------

# Centroid: v_j = sum_i (u_ij^m * x_i) / sum_i (u_ij^m)
```{r}
compute_centroids <- function(X, U, m) {
  C <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(U), ncol = ncol(X))
  for (j in 1:ncol(U)) {
    w <- U[, j]^m                       # weights u_ij^m
    for (d in 1:ncol(X)) {
      C[j, d] <- sum(w * X[, d]) / sum(w)
    }
  }
  colnames(C) <- colnames(X)
  rownames(C) <- paste0("C", 1:ncol(U))
  C
}
```

# Euclidean distance of every point to every centroid
```{r}
compute_distances <- function(X, C) {
  D <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = nrow(C))
  for (i in 1:nrow(X)) {
    for (j in 1:nrow(C)) {
      D[i, j] <- sqrt(sum((X[i, ] - C[j, ])^2))
    }
  }
  rownames(D) <- rownames(X)
  colnames(D) <- rownames(C)
  D
}
```

# Distances -> memberships: u_ij = 1 / sum_k (d_ij / d_ik)^(2/(m-1))
```{r}
distances_to_membership <- function(D, m) {
  U <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(D), ncol = ncol(D))
  for (i in 1:nrow(D)) {
    if (any(D[i, ] == 0)) {             # point sits exactly on a centroid
      U[i, D[i, ] == 0] <- 1 / sum(D[i, ] == 0)
    } else {
      for (j in 1:ncol(D)) {
        U[i, j] <- 1 / sum((D[i, j] / D[i, ])^(2 / (m - 1)))
      }
    }
  }
  dimnames(U) <- dimnames(D)
  U
}
```

# Objective: J = sum_i sum_j u_ij^m * d_ij^2
```{r}
objective <- function(U, D, m) sum(U^m * D^2)
```

## ---- 4. Random initial membership matrix (rows sum to 1) -----------
```{r}
u1 <- runif(n, 0.2, 0.8)
U0 <- cbind(C1 = u1, C2 = 1 - u1)
rownames(U0) <- rownames(dataset)
cat("\n=== Initial membership matrix U0 ===\n")
print(round(U0, 4))
```

## ---- 5. Iteration 1 ------------------------------------------------
```{r}
cat("\n================ ITERATION 1 ================\n")
C1 <- compute_centroids(dataset, U0, m)
cat("Centroids:\n");        print(round(C1, 4))
D1 <- compute_distances(dataset, C1)
cat("Distances:\n");        print(round(D1, 4))
U1 <- distances_to_membership(D1, m)
cat("New memberships:\n");  print(round(U1, 4))
cat("Objective J =", round(objective(U1, D1, m), 4), "\n")
cat("Max change in U =", round(max(abs(U1 - U0)), 6), "\n")

```

## ---- 6. Iteration 2 ------------------------------------------------
## ---- 7. Iteration 2 ------------------------------------------------

## ---- 8. (Optional) continue until convergence ----------------------
```{r}
U <- U1
for (it in 4:100) {
  C <- compute_centroids(dataset, U, m)
  D <- compute_distances(dataset, C)
  Unew <- distances_to_membership(D, m)
  delta <- max(abs(Unew - U))
  U <- Unew
  if (delta < 1e-6) { cat("\nConverged at iteration", it, "\n"); break }
}
cat("\nFinal centroids:\n");    print(round(C, 4))
cat("Final memberships:\n");    print(round(U, 4))

## ---- 9. Plot result ------------------------------------------------
hard <- apply(U, 1, which.max)
plot(dataset, col = hard, pch = 19, main = "FCM result (hard assignment)")
points(C, pch = 8, cex = 2, lwd = 2)
text(dataset, labels = rownames(dataset), pos = 3, cex = 0.8)


```
